description: This PHP class 'SelectedDisplayFieldDecorator' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Entity\Decorator namespace. It provides a decorator pattern implementation for the SelectedDisplayField entity, allowing additional functionality such as setting the display field by ID, utilizing traits and referencing other entities like DisplayField.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayFieldDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for the SelectedDisplayField entity, providing methods to manipulate display fields within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
